King Ranch Casserole
By: Anonymous
Published: Wednesday, December 2, 2009 - 11:27pm

Ingredients




8 corn tortillas, dipped in chicken broth
Salt
pepper to taste
1 lg. fryer, boiled
deboned
1/2 cup chopped onion
1/2 cup chopped green pepper
1 can cream of mushroom soup
1 teaspoon chili powder, sprinkled on top
1 can Rotel tomatoes
1 cup grated mild Cheddar cheese





Preparation

1 Prepare (layer) in order listed. Bake at 350 degrees for 30-40 minutes.
